**What is it?**
A one-line description of the character (species, colour, personality).

**Reference**
A sketch, pixel-art mockup, or a description of how it should look in each state
(idle, working, happy, sad, sleeping, eating).

**Will you draw it?**
- [ ] I'd like to contribute it (see CONTRIBUTING.md, "Adding a pet")
- [ ] Just a suggestion
